tasks.title: Review the community foundation and separation rules
tasks.scope: Review this documentation package against the founder's directions. APPROVED refers to the boundaries already requested, not acceptance of every detailed procedure.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm the README makes the undecided future blockchain name visible near the top.
Record that this Solana experiment is separate from a future genesis-native currency with no migration or entitlement promises.
Record owner decisions on the proposed workflow and leave unresolved choices explicitly open.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Do not merge policy changes or activate settings before review; no token launch or budget decision is implied.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Decide or explicitly defer future blockchain branding
tasks.scope: Record whether naming remains undecided between Zoora Blockchain and AAI Blockchain. Deferral is a valid outcome; the community working brand does not decide the chain name.
acceptance_criteria: Record the owner's decision or explicit deferral and date.
Keep the distinction between community token, future chain and future native currency in every affected introduction.
Do not select a token ticker, genesis economics or conversion rights as part of a naming decision.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Brand research is not approval to rename an external project, register accounts or buy domains.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Verify the official-links register
tasks.scope: Check control and intended purpose of each proposed official account, then prepare evidence-backed link updates.
acceptance_criteria: Verify the repository and organization addresses; document how account control was confirmed.
Leave website, X, Telegram and Discord unverified entries as TBD until checked.
Require owner approval for canonical token/link changes and record review date and evidence.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Do not request passwords or publish private account information. Verification is scoped evidence, not a guarantee against later compromise.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Prepare the token-information verification record
tasks.scope: Review the canonical token-information template and evidence requirements. Populate launch facts only after an actual separately approved launch and verified mint exist.
acceptance_criteria: Cover exact name, ticker, mint, launch time, decimals, supply, token program, authorities, metadata controls and liquidity evidence.
Record source, observation time/slot, verifier and unknowns separately from revoked controls.
Keep all absent launch data as TBD — DO NOT GUESS; official links reference this one token record.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No mint is created, chosen or funded by this task; a launch gate remains separate.
tasks.token_impact: Sensitive identity/authority disclosure only; no tokenomics or authority change authorized.

tasks.title: Design wallet and founder-fee disclosures
tasks.scope: Retain the founder's stated intent to receive creator fees allocated to the project for development, marketing and DEX costs. Design a record for real project-controlled wallets and receipts/expenses.
acceptance_criteria: List purpose, controller, restrictions, lock evidence, sale permissions and transaction-history source for any real wallet later disclosed.
State that no community-controlled treasury, allocation percentages or reporting schedule have been decided.
Present accounting cadence and privacy choices for owner review before making commitments.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Do not create wallets, expose secrets, move funds, promise holder revenue or treat personal callout rewards as project funds.
tasks.token_impact: Protected funding/wallet disclosure; owner review required, no routing or expenditure change authorized.

tasks.title: Choose licenses for documentation, code and media
tasks.scope: Prepare license options with official texts and compatibility notes for existing material and future contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Separate documentation, source code, research data and artwork requirements.
Identify dependency/source restrictions and ask the owner for an explicit selection.
Keep LICENSE-STATUS.md truthful until a choice is approved; do not claim the project is licensed open source prematurely.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No license grant or contributor agreement is added without owner approval.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Review community conduct and moderation
tasks.scope: Review respectful participation rules and how maintainers handle spam, impersonation, harassment and disagreements.
acceptance_criteria: Define proportionate moderation steps and a way to reconsider a decision.
Verify a usable reporting route without publishing an invented email address.
Explain that criticism and negative research results are welcome and token purchases confer no authority.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Do not appoint people, invite members or promise staffed response times without agreement.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Configure and verify private security reporting
tasks.scope: After policy approval, verify an owner-controlled private route and update SECURITY.md accurately. Prepare a redacted incident-response exercise.
acceptance_criteria: Check whether GitHub private vulnerability reporting can be enabled and record the actual configuration.
Verify receipt using a harmless test report with no exploit or credentials.
Document triage ownership, remediation communications and reporting fallback without inventing an SLA.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Configuration needs appropriate admin access. The policy file and public security-question template do not themselves enable private reporting.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Activate the selected proposal, label and board workflow
tasks.scope: After plan review, configure the selected labels and optionally a native GitHub Project. Open only the tasks the owner chooses, retaining planning IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Apply the 10 defined status labels and chosen type labels without duplicating existing equivalents.
Create agreed board fields/views and map actual issue URLs to planning IDs.
Keep a single status record; verify label/board consistency and mark optional Discussions as inactive unless actually enabled.
tasks.risks_and_gates: This draft contains a board specification and 25 bodies only. Bulk issue creation and platform changes are later actions.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Verify protected-change review controls
tasks.scope: Review CODEOWNERS and available main-branch protections, then select enforceable review settings with the owner.
acceptance_criteria: Document owner approval and additional review requirements for all protected economic/control changes.
Check available ruleset or branch-protection features and bypass permissions rather than assuming enforcement.
Use a harmless PR to verify the configured process; identify a qualified additional reviewer before sensitive work.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Do not invent required CI checks or review evidence. A sole author cannot provide their own approving GitHub review.
tasks.token_impact: Protects supply, authorities, fees, migration, governance, treasury and wallets; no such changes are implemented.

tasks.title: Specify a small mobile community website
tasks.scope: Propose one mobile-friendly page explaining the experiment, its current status, contribution paths and canonical links.
acceptance_criteria: Produce a wireframe and content draft with visible future-chain name uncertainty.
Use clearly marked unknown data and links to the canonical token record.
Estimate operating cost and define accessibility checks before selecting hosting.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No paid service, website publication, wallet connection or token sale is authorized.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Specify Telegram community commands
tasks.scope: Use AAI-P-0001 to design one useful read-only conversation first, then evaluate additional commands.
acceptance_criteria: Show /help, official-info and missing/stale-data examples; command names are proposals.
Document permissions, retention, provider limits and notification consent.
Clarify how the new idea relates to the private scanner without duplicating or publishing private code.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No wallet secrets or trade execution. Do not post messages, install group bots or expose BotFather tokens.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Complete the private scanner acceptance record
tasks.scope: Prepare and, only when deployment is separately authorized, complete checks for the existing AAI Scan private pilot. Current evidence: merged code, 29 offline tests and one public-data request; live operation remains pending.
acceptance_criteria: Record version, date, procedure and evidence for permitted-user access, scan/watch/compare and report clarity.
Cover Telegram delivery, restart persistence, restore and provider failures; leave unperformed checks pending.
Use three synthetic report examples for ordinary, missing-data and pool-change cases; do not label token accounts as distinct holders.
tasks.risks_and_gates: APPROVED covers the existing pilot development scope only. Hosting remains paused; no automatic deployment, paid resources or release claim.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Research durable scanner alert delivery
tasks.scope: Describe queue/outbox options for the scanner, including retry, expiry, deduplication and restart behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Specify successful, failed, timed-out and ambiguous-delivery cases.
Show how alerts survive restarts and avoid uncontrolled duplicate notification loops.
Document costs and limits; do not claim exactly-once delivery without evidence.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Design only; implementation requires private-repository access and a separately accepted scope.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Define token, pool and holder metrics
tasks.scope: Create a data dictionary for sources and definitions before charts, rankings or holder claims are implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish supply, market cap, liquidity, volume, token accounts and unique owners.
Specify timestamps, refresh expectations, pool-selection rules, missing values and deduplication.
Record provider terms, cost, coverage and confidence limitations without fabricating data.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Token account counts, price rises and historical peaks must not be presented as safety, user profit or causal proof.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Draft the read-only dashboard MVP
tasks.scope: Use AAI-P-0002 to design a synthetic dashboard showing project activity alongside sourced token and disclosed-wallet observations.
acceptance_criteria: Provide mobile wireframes for normal, unknown, stale and unavailable states.
Show proposal/work status and distinguish documentation, code and deployed services.
Make any optional contributor recognition criteria reviewable and resistant to spam.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No wallet connection, trading, hidden ranking incentives or invented treasury balances.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Draft a public GitHub development feed
tasks.scope: Use AAI-P-0003 to specify a feed of public tasks, PRs, releases, milestones and contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Display actual public issue/PR URLs and task statuses without implying private code access.
Differentiate merged source from a published release and a deployed service.
Define caching, API-failure behavior and opt-in notification preferences.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Do not leak private scanner metadata or send unsolicited messages; begin with a read-only design.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Specify a minimal Discord integration
tasks.scope: Describe an optional community command or development-update integration with minimal permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Identify one user need, one channel flow and the required permissions.
Define opt-in behavior, retention, moderation controls and removal steps.
Estimate operating cost and leave real installation and Discord account verification pending.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No server creation, invitations, token collection or unsolicited notifications.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Prepare community branding and meme-tool concepts
tasks.scope: Use AAI-P-0004 to propose an editable asset pack and, optionally, a later meme-generator concept.
acceptance_criteria: Provide asset provenance, font/media usage terms and editable sources.
Test avatar-scale readability and mobile contrast with clearly labeled mockups.
Avoid mint-like placeholders, profit promises or branding that settles the undecided future-chain name.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Review concepts before publication; no domain purchase, advertising spend or token naming decision.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Research wallet profiles and service-payment utility
tasks.scope: Compare wallet identity, badges/token gates and one AAI service-credit idea; select at most one narrow design for a later proposal.
acceptance_criteria: Explain user benefit and compare a wallet-free approach.
For a payment concept, specify quote, consent, confirmation, duplicate/incorrect/late payment, service failure and refund states using test assets only.
Document privacy, replay and permission risks; state no future-chain or native-currency rights.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No custody, wallet secrets, mainnet transfers, automated trades or token utility promise. Separate security/program review precedes any implementation.
tasks.token_impact: Potential future token utility only; asset identity, pricing, wallets and governance remain undecided.

tasks.title: Review a future bounty policy
tasks.scope: Use AAI-P-0006 and the bounty policy draft to define reviewed work and payment terms before any paid offer.
acceptance_criteria: Specify scope, acceptance criteria, reviewer, dispute/cancellation rules and source of approved funding.
Use the proposed bounty stages with evidence requirements and actual payment confirmation.
Record owner acceptance of the arrangement before publishing any bounty.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Deferred until funding and review structure exist. No amounts, recipients, custody design or real-money payouts are authorized.
tasks.token_impact: Potential project expenditure only; no token-holder revenue or rewards promised.

tasks.title: Design the launch-history research cohort
tasks.scope: Extend the launch-study protocol to compare complete eligible cohorts, including failures, with reproducible definitions of liquidity, volatility and large runs.
acceptance_criteria: Define inclusion windows, success/failure outcomes, censoring, missing data and observation dates before analysis.
Prevent future-data leakage and report survivorship, coverage and selection limitations.
Compare hypotheses with baselines; distinguish correlation from causation and publish negative findings.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No claim of a perfect launch, guaranteed runner or volatility control; no purchase of datasets or manipulation strategy.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Evaluate jellyfish-inspired model sources
tasks.scope: Inventory primary biological research and accessible datasets for a possible bio-inspired offline model; crow alternatives can be compared explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Record species, source, model resolution, available data, licenses and unknowns.
Separate actual mapped biological data from an analogy or animal-themed crypto branding.
Define a small replay/paper benchmark against simple baselines and a no-trade case, including costs and failure assumptions.
tasks.risks_and_gates: No claim that a biological model is profitable or reproduces a nervous system without evidence. No wallet connection or automatic trading.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Specify one offline XAUUSD strategy experiment
tasks.scope: Write an unambiguous strategy and evaluation specification for the gold EA research idea, without executing orders.
acceptance_criteria: Define entry, exit, invalidation, session, sizing and exposure rules.
Record data/broker assumptions and spread, commissions, swaps, slippage and data limitations.
Reserve a later evaluation period; report drawdowns, losing periods and negative results.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Offline simulation only under current rules. No broker connection, demo/live automatic orders, credentials or performance promise.
tasks.token_impact: Community tooling/documentation only; no token behavior change authorized.

tasks.title: Define future-blockchain relationship research boundaries
tasks.scope: Record questions for a separate future protocol research process under an undecided Zoora or AAI name. Preserve native-genesis intent and separation from the Solana experiment.
acceptance_criteria: List research questions and unresolved governance, technical, security and applicable legal-review needs.
Preserve the seven-step research/design/review/proposal/approval/testing path before any relationship is considered.
Explain that conceptual migration mechanisms and backing constraints confer no conversion, native currency, bridge, validator, revenue or governance rights.
tasks.risks_and_gates: Deferred until a separate research scope is accepted. No bridge design, migration announcement, token allocation or chain implementation is approved.
tasks.token_impact: Potential future relationship only; NOT PROMISED and no current monetary-architecture change.
